title: A deployment record (DEPLOY-10)
description: What one deployment did, in a shape every CI can produce: deploy/record makes it from flags, a GitHub Actions or GitLab job's environment, a GitHub deployment_status payload, a pipeline log line or any JSON; menger's deployments.record (DEPLOY-11) takes it as its parameters. A deployment never changes a ticket's status (DEPLOY-9 'status'); its tickets are those its commits are linked to, plus any it names (DEPLOY-9 'mapping'); an environment is a project's ((project, environment), DEPLOY-9 'env-identity').

project.description: Whose environment: a shortcode, or a project name menger maps to one.

environment.description: The environment's name within its project: test, staging, prod, pr-412 …

state.description: started: under way, revision not yet confirmed running. succeeded: revision runs. failed: revision was tried and did not come up healthy (what runs is not asserted). rolled_back: the environment was returned to revision, taking previous back out.

revision.description: The commit now running (for failed: the one tried) — an abbreviated or full hash, or repo@hash for a commit outside the project's repository.

previous.description: The commit that ran before, when known; same spelling as revision.

commits.description: Every commit in previous..revision, oldest first, when the CI can list them (deploy/record --commits-from-git); omitted, menger works from what it has seen.

tickets.description: Ticket ids the CI names itself, added to those the commits give.

release.description: The artifact's name, when there is one.

at.description: When, in UTC: RFC 3339 with a Z.

from.description: DEPLOY-21: the environment this one promotes from (test, for prod), set with the record; omitted, left as it was.

source.description: Where the record came from and where to read the run.

system.description: menger-pipeline, github-actions, github, gitlab, or any name a CI gives itself.

run.description: The run's identity in that system (a run id, a pipeline action).
